title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe: the pit lane is busy
body: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe's server is taking shape on our shared NEX host. It builds, starts, listens on the game's protocol block and creates its schemas; the next milestone is console contact, which nothing here has seen yet. One known gap sits in the shared host's login crypto, where a key size must grow to what the Switch expects — tracked, not hidden. Racing online again is the goal; this is the honest state of the pit lane.
